_comment: Minimum safe versions for dependencies with known critical CVEs. Update when new advisories drop. Only direct dependencies in package.json are checked (see scripts/version-floor-check.sh) — floors for packages we do not depend on directly can never fire.

next.reason: CVE-2025-66478 (RCE), CVE-2025-29927 (auth bypass), CVE-2025-55184 (DoS), CVE-2026-23864 (DoS). Also covers the React Server Components RCE (CVE-2025-55182, CVSS 10.0): the react-server-dom-* runtime ships inside next, so it is not a direct dependency and must be enforced through the next floor. November 2026: GHSA-673q-mjm6-r5xr (unauthenticated RCE), GHSA-2464-fhr4-w9xw (SVG image-optimization RCE), and GHSA-p3m5-59mp-jv5r (Server Actions DoS) are fixed in 16.4.1. Cache-component advisories GHSA-mfr8-8qww-v76h, GHSA-vc7v-qv4w-wrv8, GHSA-rhh4-g77r-r9qj, GHSA-vvgp-ww4w-46vf, GHSA-pc58-hwjq-p385, GHSA-7qx7-33qx-rqx2, and GHSA-f3mh-rxg3-f5g2 are fixed in 16.4.5.
